v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Símeon iustus * et timorátus exspectábat redemptiónem Israël, et Spíritus Sanctus erat in eo.
text.en: Simeon was just * and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Ghost was upon him.

text.la: Respónsum accépit Símeon * a Spíritu Sancto, non visúrum se mortem, nisi vidéret Dóminum.
text.en: It was revealed unto Simeon * by the Holy Ghost that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord.

text.la: Accípiens Símeon * Púerum in mánibus, grátias agens benedíxit Dóminum.
text.en: Simeon took * the Child up in his arms, and gave thanks, and blessed the Lord.

text.la: Lumen ad revelatiónem géntium, * et glóriam plebis tuæ Israël.
text.en: A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

text.la: Obtulérunt * pro eo Dómino par túrturum aut duos pullos columbárum.
text.en: They offered for Him * unto the Lord, a pair of turtle doves, or two young pigeons.

text.la: Ecce ego mitto Angelum meum, et præparábit viam ante fáciem meam. Et statim véniet ad templum sanctum suum Dominátor, quem vos quǽritis, et Angelus Testaménti, quem vos vultis.
text.en: Behold I send my angel, and he shall prepare the way before my face. And presently the Lord, whom you seek, and the angel of the testament, whom you desire, shall come to his temple.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Cum indúcerent * púerum Iesum paréntes eius, accépit eum Símeon in ulnas suas, et benedíxit Deum, dicens: Nunc dimíttis servum tuum in pace.
text.en: When His parents * brought in the Child Jesus, then took Simeon Him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said: Now lettest Thou thy servant depart in peace.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, maiestátem tuam súpplices exorámus: ut, sicut unigénitus Fílius tuus hodiérna die cum nostræ carnis substántia in templo est præsentátus; ita nos fácias purificátis tibi méntibus præsentári.
text.en: Almighty and everliving God, we humbly beseech thy Majesty, that as thy Only-begotten Son was this day presented in the temple in substance of our flesh, so we may be presented unto thee with pure and clean hearts.
